label: Applying to the Netherlands for autumn 2027

milestones.label: Create your Studielink account
milestones.note: Not an official deadline. With a Dutch address you log in with DigiD, which the government says takes about five days. Without one you upload a scan or photo of your passport or EU identity card and Studielink verifies it automatically. Either way, do it well before 15 January.

milestones.label: Numerus fixus applications close
milestones.note: Two numerus fixus programmes at most; medicine, dentistry, dental hygiene and physiotherapy allow one application per programme, so not medicine at two universities. Missing this does not cost you the year, but it does cost you every selective programme in it.

milestones.label: Ranking numbers issued
milestones.note: Selection runs between 15 January and 15 April and every applicant receives a ranking number through Studielink. Indicative: Nuffic’s date, not the government’s.

milestones.label: Applications close for everything else
milestones.note: Apply by 1 May and you are entitled to admission to a non-selective programme you qualify for. The government says a first application after 1 May may be refused - the programme can still take you, but does not have to. Some institutions set earlier dates of their own, and theirs is the one that binds.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Both Dutch deadlines fall well before this. How a conditional place pending results is handled is set by each institution; ask yours.

notes: The 15 January and 1 May deadlines are on the government page. The selection window and ranking date come from the promotion agency and need an authoritative confirmation.
